Ava (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we’re rolling out a simplified PTO accrual model + a new 40-hour Wellness Bank. Changes take effect 2026-05-01. Full FAQ + examples below: https://intranet.redwood/people/pto-accrual-2026

Ava (People Ops): TL;DR: 1) one simplified tiered accrual schedule (see example), 2) up to 80h carryover cap, 3) optional cash-out up to 40h at year-end (opt-in), 4) new hires pro-rated, contractors unchanged.

Priya: Thanks! Quick q — how do we pro-rate new hires? Any examples?

Diego (People Ops): New hires: (annual allotment * days employed / 365), rounded to nearest hour. Example in the FAQ. Contractors: no change — follow contractor agreements.

Sam: Manager approvals — still required for short notice or overlapping time? Any self-serve?

Ava (People Ops): Managers still approve >=3 consecutive days or >40% of team overlap. Wellness Bank requests under 8h can be self-scheduled through the time-off UI.

Liam: Does this apply globally? APAC/local law overrides?

Diego (People Ops): Local law always wins. For APAC we adjusted the local holiday calendar and added 5 regional days in the portal. Accrual stays the same unless local statutory minima mandate more.

Priya: Is there a carryover transition year for 2026? I have more hours than the new cap.

Ava (People Ops): Transition rule: 2026 only — we’ll allow a one-time grandfathered carryover amount equal to your 2025 balance capped at 120h. After 2026, the standard 80h cap applies.

Sam: Can employees elect cash-out now or only at year-end?

Diego (People Ops): Cash-out is year-end only (annual payroll process). You must opt-in in the portal by 2026-11-15 to cash out up to 40h.

HR-Bot: Document published: https://intranet.redwood/people/pto-2026-v2 (published by Ava) :tada:

Priya: Can we get a short AMA for questions?

Ava (People Ops): Yup — AMA scheduled: 2026-04-28 16:00 PT. Invite sent to all. Agenda: accrual examples, carryover transition, manager guidance. :calendar:

Sam: Appreciate it. :thumbsup:
